key.name: default-identity
key.description: Identifier (npub) for the default/active identity (non-sensitive).

key.name: identity-labels
key.description: Map of npub to display label for each identity.

key.name: theme
key.description: Theme preference: 'system', 'light', 'dark', or 'high-contrast'.

key.name: high-contrast-variant
key.description: Color scheme for high contrast mode: 'default' (black on white), 'inverted' (white on black), or 'yellow-on-black'.

key.name: force-high-contrast
key.description: Always use high contrast theme regardless of system settings. When false, high contrast is only used when the system requests it or theme is set to 'high-contrast'.

key.name: language
key.description: Language code for the UI (e.g., 'ja', 'es', 'pt_BR', 'id', 'fa'). Empty string uses system default.

key.name: window-width
key.description: Last window width in pixels.

key.name: window-height
key.description: Last window height in pixels.

key.name: window-maximized
key.description: Whether the window was maximized.

key.name: lock-timeout-sec
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before locking the signer UI and keys. 0 disables auto-lock.

key.name: session-lock-on-idle
key.description: Automatically lock the session when the system goes idle or the screen locks.

key.name: session-require-password
key.description: Whether a password is required to unlock the session. When false, the session can be unlocked without authentication.

key.name: session-warning-sec
key.description: Seconds before auto-lock to show a warning. 0 disables the warning.

key.name: remember-approvals
key.description: Whether to remember app approvals according to ACL policies.

key.name: approval-ttl-hours
key.description: Hours to remember an approval decision. 0 means forever.

key.name: require-confirmation-kinds
key.description: Event kinds that always require user confirmation (e.g., DMs, long-form).

key.name: relays
key.description: List of Nostr relay URLs (ws:// or wss://) for bunker and signing operations. Values should be normalized (lowercase scheme/host, no trailing slash).

key.name: tor-socks
key.description: SOCKS5 proxy URI for Tor (e.g., socks5://127.0.0.1:9050).

key.name: use-tor-for-relays
key.description: Route all relay connections through Tor proxy.

key.name: bootstrap-relays
key.description: Initial relays to connect to before fetching user's relay list.

key.name: bunker-enabled
key.description: Expose remote signer interface as per NIP-46.

key.name: bunker-relays
key.description: Relays to listen on for NIP-46 bunker requests.

key.name: bunker-allowed-pubkeys
key.description: Legacy client keys admitted to manual connect review, not paired or granted signing scopes. An empty list admits no new clients; persisted paired clients are checked separately.

key.name: bunker-allowed-methods
key.description: Server method ceiling, never a permission grant. Each call also requires paired admission and shared-gate policy. Empty disables these methods; connect is handled separately.

key.name: bunker-auto-approve-kinds
key.description: Ignored by the daemon. Remote signing uses per-client, per-account, per-event-kind permissions and trust policy through the shared signer gate.

key.name: client-session-timeout-sec
key.description: Seconds of inactivity before a client session expires. Default is 15 minutes (900 seconds). 0 disables timeout.

key.name: log-signing-requests
key.description: Keep an audit log of signing requests.

key.name: log-retention-days
key.description: Days to keep signing logs. 0 keeps forever.

key.name: onboarding-completed
key.description: Whether the new user onboarding wizard has been completed. Set to false to re-show on next launch.

key.name: launch-on-login
key.summary: Launch the approval UI on login without a window

key.name: pause-on-screen-lock
key.summary: Pause signing when the desktop locks
key.description: Unlocking does not resume signing. Resume explicitly in Grotto.

key.name: background-disclosure-accepted
key.description: Never request portal permission before setup disclosure or an explicit Settings choice.

key.name: autostart
key.description: Start the signer daemon automatically on user login.

key.name: start-minimized
key.description: Start the application minimized to system tray.

key.name: account-order
key.description: Order of accounts in the account selector (npub list).

key.name: hardware-keystore-enabled
key.description: Use platform hardware security (TPM/Secure Enclave) to protect the master signing key.

key.name: hardware-keystore-mode
key.description: Mode for hardware keystore: 0=disabled, 1=hardware-only, 2=with-fallback, 3=auto.

key.name: hardware-keystore-fallback
key.description: If hardware keystore is unavailable, fall back to software-protected keystore.

key.name: hardware-keystore-identities
key.description: List of npubs that use hardware-derived signing keys.
